## Checklist

- [ ] The file is in `reports/<problem-slug>/` and its `problem:` number matches the folder.
- [ ] Every figure has a source in `sources:`, or is marked as an estimate.
- [ ] `status:` is `draft` or `generated` (only reviewers set `reviewed`).
- [ ] Gaps are listed rather than guessed.
